description: Make a new sound effect from a description when the library has nothing suitable (search_sounds has no full match and its closest sounds do not suit; it then returns generate_available). Needs an SFXMint API key and uses the account's 3 free tries first, then a pass or plan on the account — a 24-hour pass ($3.90, 50 sounds) or a plan ($9.90 for 7 days or $19.90 for 30 days, unlimited sounds) — each up to 4 CC0 WAV takes of up to 10 s; one that makes no take does not count; with neither it answers payment_required with buy_url and website_url (the website's page where the user can make it and hear it first). Returns CC0 WAV files (signed links valid 15 minutes) with SHA-256 and seed; if they are not ready within about 25 seconds, it returns the order id for get_generation. AI-generated: the user should listen before use.

duration_s.description: Longest length in seconds. Leave it out and SFXMint chooses from the description; either way the silence before and after the sound is cut, so a take can be shorter

enhance.description: Recommended: SFXMint writes the prompt into the description the model gets, as the website's AI Enhance does, and the result gives that description. Default false: the prompt goes to the model exactly as written.

prompt.description: The sound the user needs, in plain words and any language: what it is for and what should be heard. With enhance (recommended), SFXMint writes the description the model gets. Leave out lengths (use duration_s).

variations.description: How many takes to make (default 4; one generation either way)

name: generate_sound
